cohort: 300 pregnant women diagnosed with Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study revealed that IUGR was common among multigravida women (75%) from rural areas (55.6%), and neonates with IUGR experienced morbidity in 36% of cases and mortality in 1.7% of cases.
mod_finding: 66% of pregnant women with IUGR required a caesarean section.
birth_weight: For 62.4% of neonates, birth weight ranged between 2.5 and 3.0 kg.
